biggest_catch: GreatCanadianRebates.ca's own payments page requires a 58-day minimum wait before rebates pay out — the opposite of fast-pay.
catches: Official GCR payments page: PayPal and direct-deposit payouts require a balance of $12+ for over 58 days.
Official reason: 'There is a minimum 58 day wait to get your rebates because we need that time to track returns for purchases and to collect money from the merchants.'
Payments are made monthly on the business day nearest the 28th.
A 58-day minimum wait fails the fast-pay-only rule outright, regardless of the portal's legitimacy.

c1.evidence: Official greatcanadianrebates.ca/aboutpayments.php, fetched live 2026-09-23: $12 threshold, PayPal/direct deposit, 58-day minimum wait.

c2.evidence: Variable percentage cashback; no fixed bonus amount.

c4.evidence: No card/MLM/pay-to-play issue — the failure is timing.

notes: Researched 2026-09-23. Rejected: the official payments page admits a 58-day minimum wait, explicitly violating the fast-pay-only rule. Kept as a reject record so it is not re-researched.
